blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The country’s national carbon intensity continues to rise despite growing private-sector efforts to cut emissions, the Climate Change Commission (CCC) said. At the recent Philippine Net Zero Conference 2026, CCC Secretary Robert E.A. Borje said the local market’s fossil carbon dioxide emissions have jumped by 25 percent since 2021. READ: DOF ramps up climate financing push with Asean+3, Jica support “At the national level, the absolute emissions trajectory still moves, however, in the opposite direction,” Borje said.
